Class SlotGroupRegionMath

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.core.SlotGroupRegionMath
@Internal public final class SlotGroupRegionMath extends Object
Pure coordinate resolver for SlotGroupContext regions. Post-§0042 split companion to MenuKit's RegionMath (which resolves MenuContext + HudContext regions).

Pure by design. No registry state, no Panel references, no per-frame side effects. Same shape as RegionMath — given explicit inputs (slot-group bounds, panel dimensions, stacking prefix), returns the panel's screen-space origin or Optional.empty() if the panel's extent exceeds the slot group's available space.

Lives in MenuKit: Containers because slot-group regions reference SlotGroupRegion (slot-group enum) and SlotGroupBounds (slot-group bounding rectangle) — slot-related types per §0042.

  • Method Details

    • availableSlotGroupWidth

      public static int availableSlotGroupWidth(SlotGroupRegion region, SlotGroupBounds b, int sw, int margin)
      OUTER available width for a slot-group-anchored panel before it crosses the screen-edge margin (Pass 3). Mirrors RegionMath.availableMenuWidth(MenuRegion, ScreenBounds, int, int) exactly — same per-region anchor geometry — but anchored to the SlotGroupBounds rather than the menu frame, reusing RegionMath's shared growth-direction arithmetic so the budget math lives in one place.

    • resolveSlotGroup

      public static Optional<ScreenOrigin> resolveSlotGroup(SlotGroupRegion region, SlotGroupBounds bounds, int pw, int ph, int prefix, int sw, int sh)
      Resolves a SlotGroupContext region panel's origin. Anchors to the slot group's bounding rectangle (SlotGroupBounds) rather than the screen frame, but is otherwise identical to RegionMath.resolveMenu(MenuRegion, ScreenBounds, int, int, int, int, int) — same anchor semantics, same overflow cutoff, same RegionConstants.MENU_STACK_GAP spacing.

      Bounds are computed per frame by SlotGroupPanelRegistry walking the slot list for the target category.
